name: Pansy Division
label: Lookout!
lede: Jon Ginoli ran a want ad for gay musicians into the Ramones and Buzzcocks, and Chris Freeman answered. A thousand shows later, they're still the loud, funny, unapologetic gay band rock never had.

eras.title: An ad in the paper
eras.text: Ginoli starts out solo, then puts a want ad in the paper and gets a band. The plan is simple and, in rock, unheard of: gay men singing about gay sex and gay romance with no wink and no disguise.

years.h: [[Jon Ginoli|a6969636-a63a-456f-90fe-82bf59078154]] records a first cassette in Champaign, Illinois
years.p: Bassist Chris Bowe plays on the 1991 tape. Nine of its tracks end up on the debut album.
years.xp: The material on Undressed was recorded between July 1991 and August 1992, and the earliest sessions were the independent cassette with a different line-up.

years.big: "We're going to be the gay band that actually sings about it."
years.src: Wikipedia: Pansy Division · Xtra: Pansy Division thirty years
years.h: A want ad for gay musicians into the Ramones and Buzzcocks
years.p: Ginoli runs the notice in the San Francisco Weekly. [[Chris Freeman|8853ba49-6415-4730-8c6b-7f90a015f065]] answers, and with drummer Jay Paget they become what they call the first entirely out gay rock band.
years.xp:
The ad also named early Beatles as a reference point. Freeman joined on bass and vocals and has stayed for the whole run.

Ginoli had been involved with ACT UP in San Francisco, and the line above is how he described the band's aim to Xtra.

eras.title: Lookout! and the Green Day summer
eras.text: Berkeley's Lookout! Records signs them and gets a record a year. In 1994 they land on a Green Day tour, playing to teenagers who came for someone else.

years.h: Undressed opens the Lookout! account
years.p: Thirty-three minutes of crunchy, explicit pop-punk. AllMusic picked out the Byrds-flavored "Boyfriend Wanted".
years.xp: Trouser Press said the band's lyrics cut right to the chase, and Robert Christgau gave it a one-star honorable mention. For the 30th anniversary, Lookout!'s Larry Livermore and cover model Alex Fazekas-Paul joined an interview series, and the album came first in a run of remastered vinyl reissues.

years.src: Xtra: Pansy Division thirty years · Pansy Division: Bio
years.h: Deflowered puts condom instructions in the liner notes
years.p: The second album mixes sex songs with pieces about the AIDS crisis. Ginoli adds safer-sex advice and a list of youth resources.
years.xp:
Ginoli told Xtra the band felt they had to give more information, not just jokes. The liner notes carried "a list of every gay organization in this country, organized by state," and "people did tell me that they called those numbers."

The title later became the name of his memoir.
play: Fem in a Black Leather Jacket

years.cap: Green Day with Pansy Division, Auditorium de Verdun, Montreal, Nov. 30, 1994
years.src: Pansy Division: Bio · Wikipedia: Pansy Division
years.h: Green Day takes Pansy Division on the road at the height of Dookie
years.p: Lookout! labelmates Green Day take them out for a couple of months, in front of thousands of high school kids a night.
years.xp:
Ginoli recalled: "When we started our band we thought we'd be playing our music to people in their 20s & 30s who were gay or gay-friendly."

In New York, Howard Stern met the band backstage and spent a segment talking about them on his nationally syndicated radio show.

years.h: Pile Up carries "Smells Like Queer Spirit"
years.p: The third album also has a version of "Cowboys Are Frequently, Secretly Fond of Each Other".

years.h: Underwear photos and trading cards go out on a Canadian tour
years.p: On a 1995 run through eastern Canada, the band hands out underwear photography and trading cards of themselves.

eras.title: A drummer who stays, a video that airs once
eras.text: Illades sits down for good, Goodwin adds a second guitar, and the songs get more serious. The one MTV airing of a video gets mentioned for years.

years.h: [[Luis Illades|cc520ad0-376d-4ce0-bfc0-6f310187e72d]] takes the drum stool for good
years.p: Illades becomes the permanent drummer in 1996, ending a run of changing drummers. He's still there.
years.xp: A fan-shot full set from El Mocambo in Toronto, 1996, shows the band on tour that year.

years.h: "I Really Wanted You" airs on MTV, once
years.p: The video for the Wish I'd Taken Pictures single plays a single time, a rare spot for an openly gay punk band.

years.h: Patrick Goodwin adds a lead guitar
years.p: Goodwin joins in 1997 and stays until 2004.

years.h: More Lovin' From Our Oven gathers the B-sides
years.p: Lookout! puts out a compilation of rarities and B-sides from the first years.

years.h: Absurd Pop Song Romance trades jokes for heartache
years.p: The last album for Lookout! is more romantic and more grown-up, and drops much of the early raunch.

years.h: Rancid takes them out on the Life Won't Wait tour
years.p: The band opens for the Bay Area punk veterans in support of the 1998 album Life Won't Wait.

eras.title: Alternative Tentacles, and a slower pace
eras.text: Lookout! gives them less support than they want, so the band moves to Jello Biafra's label. Pride festivals and local shows fill the calendar while the line-up shuffles.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pansy Division · Pansy Division: Bio
years.h: Alternative Tentacles releases Total Entertainment!
years.p: The first record on [[Jello Biafra|2280ca0e-6968-4349-8c36-cb0cbd6ee95f]]'s label has the same humor and sharper songs.
years.xp: The band signed with Alternative Tentacles in 2001, citing too little support from Lookout!. Wikipedia dates the album to 2003, though the band's own bio says 2000. Activity slowed afterwards and the group mostly played pride festivals and local shows.

years.cap: Pansy Division live at The Conservatory, Oklahoma City
years.h: Joel Reader takes over on lead guitar
years.p: Reader, who joins in 2004, replaces Goodwin after a brief stint by temporary guitarist Bernard Yin.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pansy Division · Pansy Division: Bio
years.h: Thirty tracks and a DVD on The Essential Pansy Division
years.p: Alternative Tentacles collects the career so far, with video and concert footage.

eras.title: A documentary, a memoir, a fresh record
eras.text: Nearly two decades in, the band tours with the Avengers, gets its own documentary, and Ginoli puts the story in a book.

years.h: The Avengers share the bill on the first national tour since 2003
years.p: Pansy Division goes out across the country with the reformed San Francisco punk band.
years.xp: The Oklahoma City stop, at The Conservatory, was photographed that October.

yt: Life in a Gay Rock Band, full documentary
years.h: Michael Carmona's documentary heads to the film festivals
years.p: Pansy Division: Life in a Gay Rock Band plays LGBT festivals around the world, then comes out on DVD in 2009.

years.h: Ginoli tells it all in Deflowered: My Life in Pansy Division
years.p: The memoir comes out on Cleis Press.

years.src: Wikipedia: Pansy Division · Pansy Division: Bio
years.h: That's So Gay brings the noise back
years.p: The album goes back to loud and fast, and ships with a live DVD.

years.h: Quite Contrary marks 25 years, led by "Blame the Bible"
years.p: Recorded in 2015 and followed by tours of both coasts.

eras.title: Chasing a thousand shows
eras.text: A younger, queerer audience turns up, the band opens for Bikini Kill and the B-52s, and a round number gets closer.

years.h: Queercore: How to Punk a Revolution puts them in the scene's history
years.p: Yony Leyser's documentary places Pansy Division among the bands that built queercore.

years.src: Pansy Division: Bio · Wikipedia: Pansy Division
years.h: Opening for Bikini Kill at Mosswood Meltdown
years.p: The band plays Oakland's Mosswood Meltdown festival ahead of [[Bikini Kill|1397d045-1603-41fc-80b9-712c18360145]].

years.h: Back at Mosswood, this time with the B-52s
years.p: The band returns to Mosswood Meltdown, supporting The B-52s.

years.big: "It's not the end, but if you want to see us live, don't wait till next time."
years.h: Show number 1,000, in San Francisco
years.p: On April 19, 2025 the band reaches its long-time goal, in the city where it started.
years.xp: The line above is how the band put it on its own bio page. Ginoli and Freeman, both from the 1991 line-up, are still in the group with Illades and Reader.
